en: I let a pleasant breeze lead me\nall the way here.
Giggle… You're so cute when you're\ndetermined.
I want to go to the woods over\nthere, but…\pThere are lots of BUG POKéMON.\nThey scare me a little.
I'm practicing in secret so no one\ncan see me.
Nobody saw me losing, right?
As a performer, I don't want people\nto know about the effort I put in.
What, you're suggesting that you're\nsick of seeing SWIMMERS like me?\pAww, don't be hatin'!
Oh, no, no, no.
I couldn't lift the stigma of being\na SWIMMER…
My boyfriend's always busy, so I\ncome swimming by myself.
Awww, I knew this would happen!
When I can't be with my boyfriend,\nI spend time with the POKéMON he\lgave me.
Tell me, where are the mountains\naround these parts?
I lost my way while I was busy\nbattling!
Aren't there any mountains around\nthese parts?

MIA: You're mean!\nYou're bad for winning!
